policy: These are versioned technical safety ceilings selected for Beta 1.0 construction, not product business caps. Exceeding a ceiling fails/quarantines at the smallest safe scope before domain mutation; content is never silently truncated. Later measured tuning may change ceilings through a new parser-profile version without changing product semantics.

time_budget.rule: soft budget produces a bounded timeout/failure result and no domain mutation; it is not a partial-accept cutoff and does not conceal exact counts from a completed run

resource_rules: all archive paths are normalized and must stay inside the in-memory ZIP namespace; absolute, parent-traversal and alternate-stream style names are rejected
no limit authorizes dropping rows/columns and calling a partial parse complete
outside-matrix content is still included in security/resource scanning even when it has no domain meaning
preview virtualization never changes exact stored totals or proposal disposition visibility
